verdict.rationale: Ramp documents codified spend controls: funds restricted by amount, interval, merchant category, merchant and country, plus pre-spend limit enforcement and category blocks. It also documents approval workflows routed by spend amount, team role, vendor type or category, and in-policy expenses that are 'auto-approved because it's within policy', with its agents that 'approve when it's safe' and 'escalate when it's not'. Context-aware rules such as per diem by trip location and duration and travel policy status round out the core story. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on authoring auto-approval rules and role-based expense limits (role mainly appears in notification and routing workflows), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that only exceptions reach a human.
